name: contact-update
description: Update canonical profile attributes (job title, organization, timezone, phone, LinkedIn, etc.) on an existing contact. contact_id must be a UUID from contact-lookup or entity-context — do not invent IDs. For a new email or phone not yet associated with the contact, use contact-link-identity first; setting primaryEmail or primaryPhone requires the address to already be registered as a contact identity. primaryPhone is normalized to E.164; a number that cannot be normalized, or an address that is not registered, returns an error. Note it and do not retry, and do not fall back to memory-store for the same field.

inputs.fields: object (canonical fields to write — include only the fields being changed. Valid keys: preferredName, title, organization, primaryEmail, primaryPhone, timezone, locale, location, pronouns, linkedinUrl, bio, birthday. Pass null to clear a field.)
